list.title: Stock Counts
list.subtitle: Reconcile physical counts; variances post an adjustment and a journal.

create.title: New stock count
create.subtitle: Enter the counted quantities; posting books the variance.

postDialog.title: Post this count?
postDialog.body: Each variance posts an adjustment movement and the count posts one journal entry. This cannot be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this draft?
deleteDialog.body: This draft count will be removed. This cannot be undone.

list.title: Stock Transfers
list.subtitle: Move stock between branches; value-neutral on posting.

create.title: New stock transfer
create.subtitle: Move stock from one internal location to another.

approveDialog.title: Approve this transfer?
approveDialog.body: Marks the transfer approved, ready to post.

postDialog.title: Post this transfer?
postDialog.body: Moves each line to the destination location. This cannot be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this transfer?
deleteDialog.body: This transfer will be removed. This cannot be undone.
